sheet.div: A donor, grant, fund and budget management system for headquarters and zones/provinces — tracking every amount from a donor agreement through to the final report, so nothing leaves the system without a request and an approval.

ol.li: Grant (the MoU) — open the donor award; it is the source of all funds.
Budget — register the approved amounts by category.
Fund receipts — record the money actually received.
Acquisition (four-form) — reserve budget on a line before spending.
Expense (voucher) — post the actual payment; reserved money becomes real cost.
Advance — send cash to a zone or staff member, who becomes a debtor.
Liquidation — report and clear the advance with justified expenses.
Donor report — generate and send the budget-vs-actual report.
Close — finish liquidations and close the grant.

p.i: Golden rule: reserve → spend → report back → report to donor.

ol.li: Drafted — a Program Officer creates the acquisition: title, budget line (only lines on an Approved budget version are selectable), estimated cost, items, and any supporting documents.
Submitted — the assigned Budget Holder submits it for review.

Confirm Real Price — before committing, Finance opens the quotation wizard: quote each item against a real vendor price, name the vendor, enter the quotation reference, and attach the approved quotation document. This confirmed amount — not the original estimate — is what gets reserved and, later, posted to the journal.

Committed — Finance reserves the confirmed amount on the budget line. Commit & Reserve only becomes available once a real price has been confirmed. If the line is short, the acquisition moves to Insufficient Funds instead, with three recovery options: choose a different budget line, request an internal budget transfer, or request supplementary donor funding — each of which sends it back to Finance once resolved.
Approved — the Approving Authority signs off on the committed request.
Expense created — the approved acquisition spawns an expense that adopts the existing reserve (never reserves twice) and carries the vendor through.

dl.dd: Memorandum of Understanding — the signed donor agreement that starts a grant.
A donor-funded award tracked end to end; the source of budget.
A planned amount for one category within a grant.
Money locked against a budget line before it is spent.
The four-step request that reserves budget before an expense is made, confirmed against a real quotation before commitment.
Moves planned budget from one line to another within the same grant/version, subject to Finance Manager approval - one way to resolve an Insufficient Funds acquisition.
A tracked request asking a grant's donor for additional funds; Finance still has to action the actual budget increase once the donor approves.
The posted transaction that records actual spending against the budget.
Money actually received from a donor.
Cash sent to a zone or staff member; the holder owes it until it is reported.
Reporting and clearing an advance with justified, posted expenses.
A field office; an organisational dimension used to track spending. Regions contain Provinces, which contain Departments.
A functional unit dimension within the organisation.
The behind-the-scenes tracking account that follows a grant's money.
Planned minus committed minus actual — what is still free to spend.
Committed plus actual, as a percentage of the budget.
The budget-vs-actual report produced for, and sent to, the donor.
